what_happened: Blocker research places Step 2 (nxt-exposing deletion theorem) in LadderPump.lean's Del section, but LadderChain.lean imports LadderPump.lean (not the reverse) and the z-anchored lift it depends on lives in LadderChain.lean's Assembly section; LadderPump.lean is also at 1485 lines against the 1500 longFile limit. Plan relocates every new declaration to LadderChain.lean.

Task description and blocker research claim the residual anchor inequality is dischargeable from nxtAt_le_cntAt_add_of_next_region plus hgap and hTc. Authoring-time reading of the register relation (Drift permits n'=n+1 at every step; the forward window bounds n from above, the already-free direction) shows the upper direction nxtAt g s0 - n <= (s0 - z) - l has no landed source and is refuted by a climbing-register path. Plan makes Phase 3 a decision gate with the FAIL branch (named forward-slack side hypothesis) fully specified, per the task's own HONEST OUTCOME clause.
